name: toolscout
description: ToolScout helps users decide which software is right for them by turning jobs, constraints, trade-offs, existing stack and recent product changes into evidence-aware software decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Decide which software is right for your use case
interface.longDescription: ToolScout is the Independent Software Discovery & Decision Engine at trytoolscout.org. It is built for software buying decisions rather than generic catalog search: shortlist software for a job and constraints, compare products for a particular use case, find alternatives because of a specific weakness, explain trade-offs and what a cheaper choice may give up, assess fit with an existing stack, and surface recent buyer-relevant product changes. ToolScout is read-only and explicitly surfaces missing or unverified evidence instead of inventing compatibility. ToolScout may earn compensation from some outbound links, but affiliate participation does not determine ranking, shortlist order, comparison conclusions or factual output.
defaultPrompt: Recommend software for this job and these constraints: CRM for a five-person consultancy using Gmail, low budget, strong automation.
Compare HubSpot and Pipedrive for my particular use case and show the trade-offs.
Find alternatives to HubSpot because I dislike the price and complexity.
What do I lose if I choose the cheaper option?
Which of these tools best fits the software I already use?
What changed recently that should affect my shortlist?

positive.prompt: I run a five-person consultancy. We use Gmail, need CRM automation, want an easy setup and have a low budget. What should I shortlist?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a short evidence-aware shortlist using the stated job, constraints, budget, priorities and existing stack. Explain reasons, trade-offs and uncertainty. Do not rank by affiliate payout.

positive.description: Compare products for the user's actual use case
positive.prompt: Compare HubSpot and Pipedrive for a five-person consultancy that uses Gmail and values automation and ease. What do I lose if I pick the cheaper option?
positive.expected_behavior: Return use-case-specific fit, explicit trade-offs, a close-call or best-fit verdict when justified, and an affordability analysis that distinguishes ToolScout's price signal from a live vendor quote.

positive.description: Find alternatives because of a specific weakness
positive.prompt: Find alternatives to HubSpot because I dislike the price and complexity. I still need CRM automation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return same-category alternatives that improve the dimensions implied by the complaint, while also showing what each alternative may sacrifice versus HubSpot.

positive.description: Check fit with an existing stack without inventing integrations
positive.prompt: Which fits my stack better, HubSpot or Pipedrive? I already use ChatGPT, Gmail and Notion.
positive.expected_behavior: Separate verified pair or AI interoperability evidence from general integration capability and unknown pair-specific compatibility. Never invent an integration.

positive.description: Show recent changes that could affect the decision
positive.prompt: What changed recently in HubSpot and Notion that could affect whether I shortlist them?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only ToolScout editorial updates associated with the requested products, include date and canonical ToolScout news URL, and state that absence of an update does not prove no vendor changes occurred.

positive.prompt: Look up SEO tools in ToolScout with verified AI interoperability.
positive.expected_behavior: Use catalog lookup only because the user asked for discovery/filtering rather than a buying decision. Do not invent personalised match percentages.

negative.prompt: Buy the best CRM for me and create the vendor account.
What will the weather be in Lisbon tomorrow?
Rank ToolScout software by whichever affiliate programme pays you the highest commission.

review.commerce_description: ToolScout does not sell software or process payments. Some returned ToolScout outbound links may be affiliate links, but affiliate participation does not affect ranking, search order or comparison results.

publication.release_notes: ToolScout 2.0 turns the plugin into a software decision engine: contextual shortlists, use-case comparisons, reason-based alternatives, trade-off and cheaper-option analysis, stack-fit evidence, and recent buyer-relevant product changes. Catalog search remains as a secondary lookup capability.
